key_points: Fitch assigns Tesla a BBB investment‑grade credit rating, joining Moody’s and S&P.
JPMorgan raises TSLA price target by more than 200%, signaling strong upside expectations.
Speculation of a SpaceX‑Tesla merger circulates, hinting at potential synergies in AI and manufacturing.
Analysts note a potential Q2 delivery beat and Nvidia partnership boosting Tesla’s ‘physical AI’ push.
Concerns about weakening US EV sales persist, but are offset by the above positive developments.
